name: Locked Up and Scramble
source:
This is a fangame about Naib Subedar, Mercenary and Eli Clark, Seer, both belonging to the asymmetrical horror game Identity V, developed by NetEase Games.

[From [url=https://bluemangoo.itch.io/locked-up-and-scramble-naibeli-idv-fangame]Itch.io[/url]]
